fields.why: The Figure sets average annual deaths by age group and period side by side, which looks groupwise; but the only claim is a period increase within every age group, which rule F4 would keep out (empty list also defensible).
Sex is a pair; age is the only SPD with 3 or more groups shown.

The CI overlap assertions compare periods within all causes, cause categories and sex, never across age groups, so the flag is a false alarm. A's figure-title quote drops the asterisk after 'alcohol use', hence the 'not found' flag.

brief_issues: Rule F4 covers trends over calendar time but not a figure of per-period values by age group whose only claim is 'increased among all age groups'; the brief could say whether such a uniform within-group statement is side by side or no entry.
